summary: Comprehensive testing of CARBRIDGE MVP platform completed. Backend APIs fully functional (11/11 tests passed). Frontend core features working including landing page, calculator, authentication, dashboard, and garage functionality. Minor session persistence and UI interaction issues identified.

integration_issues.issue: User session expires after some time, redirecting to login

passed_tests: Landing page loads with all sections (Hero, Process, Advantages, Platforms, FAQ, Contacts)
Calculator works for both individual and legal entities with accurate calculations
Dashboard loads and displays user data correctly
All 11 backend API endpoints working correctly
Tender creation generates mock offers as expected
User registration and profile management working
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor fixes needed: 1) Improve session persistence to prevent unexpected logouts 2) Fix AI Chat button overlay issues for better user interaction 3) Consider adding more robust error handling for session timeouts
